megan (pm): Quick async Q2 OKR checkpoint — drop a one-line status for your milestone (shipped / slipped / partial), owner, and any CR/PR pings or blockers. I'll compile for the product doc. Looking specifically at M2: model-serving latency SLO, telemetry dashboard, rollout automation. Please reply by EOD.

raj (eng): M2.1 latency SLO -> slipped. Owner: raj. Cause: perf regression after quant kernel change. PR: #8324. Blocker: regression reproduces on long-seq paths, pinging @sam.

sam (infra): Got it — I'll repro on dedicated stack today. @raj can you paste the minimal repro trace? :eyes: 

raj (eng): trace snippet:
```
latency p99: 420ms -> 620ms after merge
kv cache misses spike on seq>1024
```
Reverted a hotfix in #8331, running bisect now.

tess (design): M2.2 telemetry dashboard — shipped :rocket: dashboards merged, owner tess. Note: follow-up to add trace correlation links in the next sprint.

megan (pm): Rollout automation (M2.3) status? Partial last I saw. Owner: luis. @luis update?

luis (eng): Canary is live at 10% traffic. Auto-fallback not working due to HSM key exchange error. Ticket ENG-4526. Slipped to next week. CR ping: #8348 — review requested.

raj (eng): @luis I can take a look at the crypto handshake tomorrow.

sam (infra): Infra action: spun up ephemeral cluster infra/cluster-qa-2026 to test fallback path. Collected logs uploaded to s3://redwood-qa/fallback-logs/2311206789/

deploy-bot: DEPLOYMENT: canary rollout started for model-serving-v2 on us-west-2 at 2026-03-16T18:05Z

megan (pm): Summary for product doc: M2 overall — telemetry shipped; rollout automation partial (canary live but auto-fallback blocked by HSM); latency SLO blocked by perf regression. Next steps: raj continue bisect + perf fix, sam infra repro and validate fallback path, luis iterate on CR & crypto fix. Please ping here if status changes before EOD :hourglass_flowing_sand:.

luis (eng): :thumbsup: I'll queue CR comments today and update ENG-4526.

raj (eng): :rocket: bisect running, will post ETA and timeline in this thread.
